newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Russian defence minister arrives at NATO.
newsitem.headline: Russian defence minister arrives at NATO.

text.p: Russian Defence Minister Igor Rodionov arrived at NATO on Wednesday for talks which could prove to be the first step in a radical new relationship with between Russia and the western military alliance.
Rodionov arrived wearing a grey suit after being transferred from the military to being a civilian last week.
The 16-nation alliance aims to strike a deal at the meeting for the exchange of military liaison officers between the NATO and Russia's military and political commands.
That would be seen as a stepping stone to a future charter or treaty offered by NATO covering all aspects of relations between NATO and its former cold war foe.

In a major change of policy Russian foreign minister Yevgeny Primakov said last week Russia wanted to open a dialogue on the charter, without a link to NATO's plans to give membership to a number of eastern European countries.
Russia is deeply opposed to the NATO enlargement plans.
